It adds clause realizers, an adjunct role arm pair, a doc-only concept-id constant in packs.rs with no PackEntry, and re-exports. Different layer of the same crate -- you change what words are, this changes how clauses are surfaced. Nothing here pins a name, so a ROOT_EPOCH v3 to v4 landing first costs us an absorb and a regenerate, not a redesign. THREE THINGS WORTH STEALING, all measured. (1) THE STANDING DRIFT CHECK CANNOT SEE AN UNREGENERATED ARTIFACT. git diff --exit-code over docs/generated-paths.txt compares the tree to itself and never re-runs a generator, so a file that was never regenerated passes it silently while being wrong. I ran it, got clean, reported zero drift, and sentence-coverage.md was stale by 12 insertions. Regenerate FIRST, then diff. A reviewer later proved the stronger form non-vacuous by perturbing both audits and confirming the generators wrote them back. (2) A REVIEW CAN DISCHARGE A NEIGHBOURING QUESTION AND READ AS DISCHARGING THE CONSTRAINT. Two independent reviews reported our token-citation constraint satisfied while two citations were absent; both said the tokens were backed by their tests and wired into the witness, which is true and is a different property. Caught only by a later task having the check as an explicit step. (3) A HEADLINE FIGURE CAN FLATTER YOU IN A DIRECTION NOBODY QUESTIONS. Our preregistration named a produce-side statistic the instrument could not compute, so we built it: produce 203 of 638 at 31.8 percent, parse 190 of 490 at 38.8, composite 393 of 1128 at 34.8. The ladder is a declared production instrument, so the half we targeted is the LOWER one and the composite was overstating us by three points. Building the split beat apologising for its absence.
